PB-C6-01.forbidden_resolution: Do not invent angle/straight/turn/opposite/vector geometry or an unapproved ordered channel annotation.
missing_typed_data: per-transition channel label assignment tied to the ordered path event history
the ingress label of the final transition of gamma at the shared packet
the egress label of the first transition of eta at the shared packet
zero-transition endpoint channel convention if such a convention is ever desired
PB-C6-01.proof_of_underdetermination: The frozen C6 state stores aggregate I/O/M counts but no ordered boundary-event selector. The same aggregate ingress counts at the join can be compatible with more than one candidate final ingress label, and the same aggregate egress counts with more than one candidate first egress label; therefore the matrix unit contributing the join cross-term is not determined by current frozen semantics.

frozen_available_state.I_x: aggregate nonnegative integer ingress counts by label
frozen_available_state.M_x: aggregate nonnegative integer ingress-label -> egress-label passage counts
frozen_available_state.O_x: aggregate nonnegative integer egress counts by label
